inputs.text: Just got this update on the latest lawsuit going after ICE for detaining thousands of people as they leave immigration courts. It's the usual progressive attack meant to tie law enforcement's hands and weaken our borders further. The argument that ICE relied on a memo from May of last year that court documents now claim gave no authorization is just another case of activists twisting technicalities to shield outsiders with no real claim to legal status. These challenges only erode the authority we need to maintain order, personal responsibility, and the cultural roots that protect American families from being exploited.
